name: dev_collateral_blocking
description: Collateral blocking — the real mutual-blocking hazard in this model. 8-CPU cluster. deadlocked-a is self-infeasible (parent 4 + child 5 = 9 > 8 max capacity): its parent PG admits (4 CPU fits), then its child can never be placed, so the trial sits in WAITING_CHILD holding 4 CPUs forever. feasible-b is feasible in isolation (parent 4 + child 4 = 8 <= 8), but its parent cannot be admitted while deadlocked-a's parent holds 4 of the 8 CPUs — and its child would need the other 4. Under FIFO and greedy BOTH trials end unresolved (greedy cannot skip a trial whose parent fits in free capacity); deadlock_aware rejects deadlocked-a at admission (combined demand exceeds max capacity) and feasible-b completes. This demonstrates why per-trial pre-admission feasibility protects not just the infeasible trial but also the feasible trials it would otherwise block.
